In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this work provides the first crystal structure of a full length AGC kinase domain and defines a key regulatory motif for the activation of PDK1.
the PIF‐motif is not a docking site, rather it is a regulatory motif that is phosphorylated to promote the interaction between PDK1 and its substrates.
the crystal structure of PDK‐1 in complex with ATP has been determined and that it defines the PIF‐motif‐interacting pocket.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have defined a phosphate‐binding regulatory site in PDK1 that is essential for the activation of certain substrates and may be targeted for inhibitor design.
we determined the structure of the P‐loop of PDK1 and identified its role in the regulation of the enzyme.
PDK1 has a phosphate‐dependent regulatory docking site that can be exploited for the design of selective inhibitors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a phosphate‐binding site in the PDK1 catalytic domain is critical for substrate recognition and phosphorylation.
the PIF pocket in PDK1 is a key site for substrate binding.
PDK1 is a unique AGC kinase in terms of its regulatory mechanism.
